lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.unitTitle: Data: Scaled Graphs and Measurement Line Plots
lessonRef.focus: choosing a representation that fits the question
lessonRef.title: Applied problem solving: choosing a representation that fits the question

sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: This example shows the kind of reasoning the problem below asks for.

items.prompt: With a scale of 2 per symbol, "Dogs" has 6 symbols and "Cats" has 4 symbols. How many more dogs than cats?

sections.title: Guided practice
sections.directions: Talk through what the problem is asking before you compute.

items.prompt: A line plot shows the lengths of 8 leaves, each measured to the nearest 1/4 inch: 4/4, 2/4, 2/4, 1/4, 4/4, 1/4, 3/4, 1/4. How many leaves measured exactly 1/4 inch?
A scaled bar graph shows a survey where each bar length equals a count of 5 per symbol. The bar for "Blue" is worth 8 symbols. How many does "Blue" represent?

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: On a scaled bar graph with 2 per symbol, "Dogs" has 9 symbols and "Cats" has 2 symbols. How many more does "Dogs" have than "Cats"?
A line plot shows the lengths of 8 leaves, each measured to the nearest 1/8 inch: 2/8, 6/8, 2/8, 5/8, 5/8, 3/8, 7/8, 4/8. How many leaves measured exactly 5/8 inch?
A scaled bar graph shows a survey where each bar length equals a count of 5 per symbol. The bar for "Cats" is worth 7 symbols. How many does "Cats" represent?

sections.title: Extension and challenge
sections.directions: Write out the reasoning in full sentences. A correct answer with no justification does not count here.

items.prompt: On a scaled bar graph with 10 per symbol, "Dogs" has 5 symbols and "Cats" has 3 symbols. How many more does "Dogs" have than "Cats"?
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.

items.prompt: A line plot shows the lengths of 8 leaves, each measured to the nearest 1/8 inch: 6/8, 4/8, 2/8, 2/8, 6/8, 6/8, 7/8, 7/8. How many leaves measured exactly 7/8 inch?
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.
